 "data": "@startuml

!define ABSTRACT abstract

' Client-side classes
class Application {
 + run()
 - displayMainMenu() const
 - handleUserSession(int, std::string, int, std::string, ServerConnection) const
 - handleAdminSession(std::string, int, std::string, ServerConnection) const
 - handleChefSession(std::string, int, std::string, ServerConnection) const
 - handleEmployeeSession(std::string, int, std::string, ServerConnection) const
 - handleServerConnectionFailure() const
}

class Admin {
 + Admin(int, std::string, ServerConnection)
 + mainMenu()
 - addUser()
 - deleteUser()
 - addMenu()
 - deleteMenu()
 - viewRecommendedMenu()
 - fetchDailyMenu() : std::pair<std::string, std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>>
 - viewMenu() : std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>
 - printDailyMenu(const std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>&)
 - id : int
 - password : std::string
 - role : std::string
 - serverConnection : ServerConnection
}

class Chef {
 + Chef(int, std::string, ServerConnection)
 + mainMenu()
 + rolloutMenu()
 + viewMenu() : std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>
 + printRecommendedFood(const std::vector<RecommendedMenuData>&)
 + fetchRecommendedFood() : std::vector<RecommendedMenuData>
 + printDailyMenu(const std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>&)
 + setMenuAvailabilityToZero()
 + fetchMenuFeedbacks()
 + deleteMenuItem()
 + writeSuggestionQuestion()
 + FoodSuggestionsForMenu()
 + fetchDiscardedMenu() : std::pair<std::string, std::vector<Menu>>
 + viewDiscardMenu()
 - id : int
 - password : std::string
 - role : std::string
 - serverConnection : ServerConnection
}

class Employee {
 + Employee(int, std::string, ServerConnection)
 + mainMenu()
 + placeOrder()
 + giveFeedback()
 + checkNotifications()
 + updateProfile()
 + viewProfile()
 + viewMenu() : std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>
 + printDailyMenu(const std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>&)
 + printNotifications(const std::vector<Notification>&)
 + printProfile(const UserProfile&)
 + fetchDailyMenu() : std::pair<std::string, std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>>
 + fetchFeedbackQuestions() : std::vector<FeedbackQuestion>
 + printFeedbackQuestions(const std::vector<FeedbackQuestion>&)
 + giveSuggestionForFood()
 + giveSuggestionForFood(int) : bool
 + sendFeedbackAnswersToServer(const std::vector<FeedbackAnswer>&) : bool
 + promptForDailyMenuId(const std::vector<DailyMenuEntry>&) : int
 - id : int
 - password : std::string
 - role : std::string
 - serverConnection : ServerConnection
}

class Authentication {
 + Authentication(ServerConnection)
 + authenticateUser(int, std::string) : std::string
 - serverConn : ServerConnection
}

class ServerConnection {
 + ServerConnection(std::string, int)
 + ~ServerConnection()
 + connectToServer() : bool
 + getSocket() : int
 + sendRequest(std::string) : bool
 + readResponse() : std::string
 - serverIp : std::string
 - serverPort : int
 - sock : int
}

Application --> Authentication : \"1\"
Application --> ServerConnection : \"uses 1\"

' Server-side classes
class DatabaseConnection {
 - static std::shared_ptr<sql::Connection> connection
 - static std::shared_ptr<DatabaseConnection> instance
 - DatabaseConnection()
 + DatabaseConnection(const DatabaseConnection&) = delete
 + DatabaseConnection& operator=(const DatabaseConnection&) = delete
 + static void initDatabaseConnection(std::string hostName, std::string userName, std::string password, std::string schemaName)
 + static std::shared_ptr<DatabaseConnection> getInstance()
 + std::shared_ptr<sql::Connection> getConnection()
 + ~DatabaseConnection()
}

class FeedbackDAO {
 + FeedbackDAO()
 + bool insertUserFeedback(Feedback &feedback)
 + bool addFeedbackQuestion(std::string questionText)
 + std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>> fetchFeedbackQuestions()
 + bool storeFeedbackAnswers(std::vector<FeedbackAnswer> &feedbackAnswers)
 + int getMenuIdFromDailyMenuId(int dailyMenuId)
 - std::shared_ptr<DatabaseConnection> dbConnection
 - std::shared_ptr<sql::Connection> connection
}

class MenuDAO {
 + MenuDAO()
 + std::vector<Menu> fetchMenusWithFeedback()
 + std::vector<Menu> fetchMenus()
 + void fetchFeedbacks(Menu &menu)
 + bool addMenu(MenuAttributes &menu)
 + bool deleteMenu(int menuId)
 + bool insertDailyMenuEntries(std::vector<DailyMenuEntry> &dailyMenuEntry)
 + std::vector<DailyMenuAttributes> getDailyMenu()
 + int getMenuIdFromDailyMenuId(int dailyMenuId)
 + std::vector<DailyMenuAttributes> getDailyMenuWithAttributes()
 + bool setDailyMenuAvailabilityToZero(int dailyMenuId)
 + std::vector<FeedbackAnswer> fetchSuggestionsForMenu(int menuId)
 - std::shared_ptr<DatabaseConnection> dbConnection
 - std::shared_ptr<sql::Connection> connection
}

class NotificationDAO {
 + NotificationDAO()
 + bool insertNotification(std::string message)
 + bool addNotification(std::string message)
 + bool markNotificationsAsViewed(int userId, std::vector<int> &notificationIds)
 - std::shared_ptr<DatabaseConnection> dbConnection
 - std::shared_ptr<sql::Connection> connection
}

class UserDAO {
 + UserDAO()
 + std::string authenticateUser(int userId, std::string password)
 + bool addUser(User &user)
 + bool deleteUser(int userId)
 + bool insertUserOrderEntries(std::vector<UserOrderEntry> &userOrderEntries)
 + std::vector<Notification> getNonViewedNotificationsForUser(int userId)
 + UserProfile fetchUserProfile(int userId)
 + UserProfile getUserProfile(int userId)
 + bool updateUserProfile(UserProfile &profile)
 - std::shared_ptr<DatabaseConnection> dbConnection
 - std::shared_ptr<sql::Connection> connection
}

interface IRecommendationEngine {
 + std::vector<RecommendedMenuData> getRecommendedFood()
 + std::vector<DailyMenuAttributes> getRecommendedFoodForUser(int userId)
 + std::vector<Menu> getDiscardedFood()
}

class RecommendationEngine {
 + RecommendationEngine(std::shared_ptr<UserDAO>, std::shared_ptr<MenuDAO>)
 + std::vector<RecommendedMenuData> getRecommendedFood() override
 + std::vector<DailyMenuAttributes> getRecommendedFoodForUser(int userId) override
 + float calculateSentimentScore(std::string feedback)
 + std::vector<DailyMenuAttributes> sortMenusByUserProfile(std::vector<DailyMenuAttributes> &menus, UserProfile &profile)
 + std::vector<Menu> getDiscardedFood() override
 - std::shared_ptr<UserDAO> userDAO
 - std::shared_ptr<MenuDAO> menuDAO
}

interface IRequestHandler {
 + void handleRequest(int newSocket)
}

class RequestHandler {
 + RequestHandler(std::shared_ptr<UserDAO>, std::shared_ptr<MenuDAO>, std::shared_ptr<NotificationDAO>, std::shared_ptr<FeedbackDAO>, std::shared_ptr<IRecommendationEngine>)
 + void handleRequest(int new_socket) override
 - std::shared_ptr<UserDAO> userDAO
 - std::shared_ptr<MenuDAO> menuDAO
 - std::shared_ptr<NotificationDAO> notificationDAO
 - std::shared_ptr<FeedbackDAO> feedbackDAO
 - std::shared_ptr<IRecommendationEngine> recommendationEngine
 - std::string readFromSocket(int new_socket)
 - std::string processRequest(const GeneralRequest &request)
 - [several private handle methods for various requests]
}
